input: Find farm camps, animal camps and homestead camps for kids for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville farm summer camp 2026 kids homestead
horse summer camp 2026 Asheville riding farm

candidates.name: Asheville Farmstead School
candidates.note: Camp Farmstead offered six themed weeks in 2026, with farm, forest, agriculture and homesteading activities.

candidates.name: Project HNG
candidates.note: Farm and equine summer day camp, formerly Hickory Nut Gap Farm Camp; also offers riding lessons.

candidates.name: Ruby Ranch
candidates.note: 2026 summer camp for ages 6–16 combines horse riding and care, gardening, art, music and creek exploration.

candidates.name: Sunny Truth Nature Programs
candidates.note: 2026 outdoor summer camp with farm animals, games, art and science; listed for ages 5–12.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: 2026 Garden Camp for ages 6–10 and CIT program for ages 11–16 include gardening, cooking and animal care.

candidates.name: Ellaberry Llama Farm
candidates.note: June 2026 camp for ages 6–13 featured llama care, showing, hikes, creek activities and fiber crafts.

candidates.name: Full Moon Equestrian
candidates.note: June 2025 day camp for ages 6+ included riding, horse care, barn chores, groundwork and horse-themed crafts.

candidates.name: Winding Creek Stables
candidates.note: Offered summer camps in 2025; now located in Rutherfordton, with an equestrian adventure camp for experienced young riders.

candidates.name: Camp Celo
candidates.note: 2027 farm-based overnight programs for ages 7–14 include animal care, garden harvesting, hiking and swimming.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley Camp
candidates.note: 2027 registration announced for overnight camp combining a farm program, wilderness activities and traditional camping.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: Two week-long Horseback Skills Camp sessions announced for 2027, with English riding instruction and horse care.

candidates.name: Hands On! Children's Museum
candidates.note: 2026 camps for rising grades 1–3 included Go Wild: Animal Adventures, exploring wildlife, habitats and animal-inspired art.
